text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Orange shade: event, between the two orange rules. Blue shade: the 7 days after the event ends. Injected events change the lag inputs only; the forecast should stay on the observed power. Real events: dashed lines use the lags as observed, solid lines the lags corrected for the event. NGED's event log may miss events, so some clean-looking rows may hold an unlogged event.'
text.tspan: Orange shade: event, between the two orange rules. Blue shade: the 7 days after the event ends.
Injected events change the lag inputs only; the forecast should stay on the observed power.
Real events: dashed lines use the lags as observed, solid lines the lags corrected for the event.
NGED's event log may miss events, so some clean-looking rows may hold an unlogged event.
